risk_note: RV2 (payout). BR-WDR-30 enable pre-check / BR-WDR-23 R2: the real ReconPassedDaysPort counts the consecutive succeeded payout_recon_runs rows of this app's alipay channel back from yesterday (+08:00 day of the injected Clock); a succeeded day with diffs still counts and partial / failed / a missing day stops the count (D10-408 ② reading A), today's row neither counts nor breaks, the query is read only, takes no lock and has no window cap. app.module wires it in place of D10-392's constant 0; an unset recon_required_days still fails the check, and until the real Alipay bill download exists only FakeChannel runs can advance the count, so the switch stays closed (D10-408). No money moves. The full verify on the test machine was stopped at 3600 s in test:int (exit 124) with this task's four rule-test files green and no failure in the log; per D10-319 the required CI verify-int decides. Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so the rule tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36); W1 took the task over from the ops lane (orchestrator 10-29 16:15).
